scene.label: Act 2, Scene 3
scene.title: SCENE III. The same. A hall of state: a banquet prepared.
scene.location: The same. A hall of state: a banquet prepared.

content.text: Enter Simonides, Thaisa, Lords, Attendants and Knights, from tilting.

lines.text: Knights,
lines.plainText: Knights

lines.text: To say you're welcome were superfluous.
lines.plainText: To say you're welcome were superfluous

lines.text: To place upon the volume of your deeds,
lines.plainText: To place upon the volume of your deeds

lines.text: As in a title-page, your worth in arms,
lines.plainText: As in a titlepage your worth in arms

lines.text: Were more than you expect, or more than's fit,
lines.plainText: Were more than you expect or more than's fit

lines.text: Since every worth in show commends itself.
lines.plainText: Since every worth in show commends itself

lines.text: Prepare for mirth, for mirth becomes a feast:
lines.plainText: Prepare for mirth for mirth becomes a feast

lines.text: You are princes and my guests.
lines.plainText: You are princes and my guests

lines.text: But you, my knight and guest;
lines.plainText: But you my knight and guest

lines.text: To whom this wreath of victory I give,
lines.plainText: To whom this wreath of victory I give

lines.text: And crown you king of this day's happiness.
lines.plainText: And crown you king of this day's happiness

lines.text: 'Tis more by fortune, lady, than by merit.
lines.plainText: 'Tis more by fortune lady than by merit

lines.text: Call it by what you will, the day is yours;
lines.plainText: Call it by what you will the day is yours

lines.text: And here, I hope, is none that envies it.
lines.plainText: And here I hope is none that envies it

lines.text: In framing an artist, art hath thus decreed,
lines.plainText: In framing an artist art hath thus decreed

lines.text: To make some good, but others to exceed;
lines.plainText: To make some good but others to exceed

lines.text: And you are her labour'd scholar. Come queen of the feast,—
lines.plainText: And you are her labour'd scholar Come queen of the feast

lines.text: For, daughter, so you are,—here take your place:
lines.plainText: For daughter so you arehere take your place

lines.text: Marshal the rest, as they deserve their grace.
lines.plainText: Marshal the rest as they deserve their grace

lines.text: We are honour'd much by good Simonides.
lines.plainText: We are honour'd much by good Simonides

lines.text: Your presence glads our days; honour we love;
lines.plainText: Your presence glads our days honour we love

lines.text: For who hates honour hates the gods above.
lines.plainText: For who hates honour hates the gods above

lines.text: Sir, yonder is your place.
lines.plainText: Sir yonder is your place

lines.text: Some other is more fit.
lines.plainText: Some other is more fit

lines.text: Contend not, sir; for we are gentlemen
lines.plainText: Contend not sir for we are gentlemen

lines.text: Have neither in our hearts nor outward eyes
lines.plainText: Have neither in our hearts nor outward eyes

lines.text: Envied the great, nor shall the low despise.
lines.plainText: Envied the great nor shall the low despise

lines.text: You are right courteous knights.
lines.plainText: You are right courteous knights

lines.text: Sit, sir, sit.
lines.plainText: Sit sir sit

lines.text: By Jove, I wonder, that is king of thoughts,
lines.plainText: By Jove I wonder that is king of thoughts

lines.text: These cates resist me, he but thought upon.
lines.plainText: These cates resist me he but thought upon

lines.text: By Juno, that is queen of marriage,
lines.plainText: By Juno that is queen of marriage

lines.text: All viands that I eat do seem unsavoury,
lines.plainText: All viands that I eat do seem unsavoury

lines.text: Wishing him my meat. Sure, he's a gallant gentleman.
lines.plainText: Wishing him my meat Sure he's a gallant gentleman

lines.text: He's but a country gentleman;
lines.plainText: He's but a country gentleman

lines.text: Has done no more than other knights have done;
lines.plainText: Has done no more than other knights have done

lines.text: Has broken a staff or so; so let it pass.
lines.plainText: Has broken a staff or so so let it pass

lines.text: To me he seems like diamond to glass.
lines.plainText: To me he seems like diamond to glass

lines.text: Yon king's to me like to my father's picture,
lines.plainText: Yon king's to me like to my father's picture

lines.text: Which tells me in that glory once he was;
lines.plainText: Which tells me in that glory once he was

lines.text: Had princes sit, like stars, about his throne,
lines.plainText: Had princes sit like stars about his throne

lines.text: And he the sun, for them to reverence;
lines.plainText: And he the sun for them to reverence

lines.text: None that beheld him, but, like lesser lights,
lines.plainText: None that beheld him but like lesser lights

lines.text: Did vail their crowns to his supremacy:
lines.plainText: Did vail their crowns to his supremacy

lines.text: Where now his son's like a glow-worm in the night,
lines.plainText: Where now his son's like a glowworm in the night

lines.text: The which hath fire in darkness, none in light:
lines.plainText: The which hath fire in darkness none in light

lines.text: Whereby I see that time's the king of men,
lines.plainText: Whereby I see that time's the king of men

lines.text: He's both their parent, and he is their grave,
lines.plainText: He's both their parent and he is their grave

lines.text: And gives them what he will, not what they crave.
lines.plainText: And gives them what he will not what they crave

lines.text: What, are you merry, knights?
lines.plainText: What are you merry knights

lines.text: Who can be other in this royal presence?
lines.plainText: Who can be other in this royal presence

lines.text: Here, with a cup that's stored unto the brim,—
lines.plainText: Here with a cup that's stored unto the brim

lines.text: As you do love, fill to your mistress' lips,—
lines.plainText: As you do love fill to your mistress' lips

lines.text: We drink this health to you.
lines.plainText: We drink this health to you

lines.text: We thank your grace.
lines.plainText: We thank your grace

lines.text: Yet pause awhile. Yon knight doth sit too melancholy,
lines.plainText: Yet pause awhile Yon knight doth sit too melancholy

lines.text: As if the entertainment in our court
lines.plainText: As if the entertainment in our court

lines.text: Had not a show might countervail his worth.
lines.plainText: Had not a show might countervail his worth

lines.text: Note it not you, Thaisa?
lines.plainText: Note it not you Thaisa

lines.text: What is't to me, my father?
lines.plainText: What is't to me my father

lines.text: O attend, my daughter:
lines.plainText: O attend my daughter

lines.text: Princes in this should live like gods above,
lines.plainText: Princes in this should live like gods above

lines.text: Who freely give to everyone that comes to honour them:
lines.plainText: Who freely give to everyone that comes to honour them

lines.text: And princes not doing so are like to gnats,
lines.plainText: And princes not doing so are like to gnats

lines.text: Which make a sound, but kill'd are wonder'd at.
lines.plainText: Which make a sound but kill'd are wonder'd at

lines.text: Therefore to make his entrance more sweet,
lines.plainText: Therefore to make his entrance more sweet

lines.text: Here, say we drink this standing-bowl of wine to him.
lines.plainText: Here say we drink this standingbowl of wine to him

lines.text: Alas, my father, it befits not me
lines.plainText: Alas my father it befits not me

lines.text: Unto a stranger knight to be so bold:
lines.plainText: Unto a stranger knight to be so bold

lines.text: He may my proffer take for an offence,
lines.plainText: He may my proffer take for an offence

lines.text: Since men take women's gifts for impudence.
lines.plainText: Since men take women's gifts for impudence

lines.text: How? Do as I bid you, or you'll move me else.
lines.plainText: How Do as I bid you or you'll move me else

lines.text: [Aside.] Now, by the gods, he could not please me better.
lines.plainText: Aside Now by the gods he could not please me better

lines.text: And furthermore tell him, we desire to know of him,
lines.plainText: And furthermore tell him we desire to know of him

lines.text: Of whence he is, his name and parentage.
lines.plainText: Of whence he is his name and parentage

lines.text: The king my father, sir, has drunk to you.
lines.plainText: The king my father sir has drunk to you

lines.text: I thank him.
lines.plainText: I thank him

lines.text: Wishing it so much blood unto your life.
lines.plainText: Wishing it so much blood unto your life

lines.text: I thank both him and you, and pledge him freely.
lines.plainText: I thank both him and you and pledge him freely

lines.text: And further he desires to know of you,
lines.plainText: And further he desires to know of you

lines.text: Of whence you are, your name and parentage.
lines.plainText: Of whence you are your name and parentage

lines.text: A gentleman of Tyre; my name, Pericles;
lines.plainText: A gentleman of Tyre my name Pericles

lines.text: My education been in arts and arms;
lines.plainText: My education been in arts and arms

lines.text: Who, looking for adventures in the world,
lines.plainText: Who looking for adventures in the world

lines.text: Was by the rough seas reft of ships and men,
lines.plainText: Was by the rough seas reft of ships and men

lines.text: And after shipwreck driven upon this shore.
lines.plainText: And after shipwreck driven upon this shore

lines.text: He thanks your grace; names himself Pericles,
lines.plainText: He thanks your grace names himself Pericles

lines.text: A gentleman of Tyre,
lines.plainText: A gentleman of Tyre

lines.text: Who only by misfortune of the seas
lines.plainText: Who only by misfortune of the seas

lines.text: Bereft of ships and men, cast on this shore.
lines.plainText: Bereft of ships and men cast on this shore

lines.text: Now, by the gods, I pity his misfortune,
lines.plainText: Now by the gods I pity his misfortune

lines.text: And will awake him from his melancholy.
lines.plainText: And will awake him from his melancholy

lines.text: Come, gentlemen, we sit too long on trifles,
lines.plainText: Come gentlemen we sit too long on trifles

lines.text: And waste the time, which looks for other revels.
lines.plainText: And waste the time which looks for other revels

lines.text: Even in your armours, as you are address'd,
lines.plainText: Even in your armours as you are address'd

lines.text: Will well become a soldier's dance.
lines.plainText: Will well become a soldier's dance

lines.text: I will not have excuse, with saying this,
lines.plainText: I will not have excuse with saying this

lines.text: 'Loud music is too harsh for ladies' heads'
lines.plainText: 'Loud music is too harsh for ladies' heads'

lines.text: Since they love men in arms as well as beds.
lines.plainText: Since they love men in arms as well as beds

lines.text: In those that practise them they are, my lord.
lines.plainText: In those that practise them they are my lord

lines.text: O, that's as much as you would be denied
lines.plainText: O that's as much as you would be denied

lines.text: Of your fair courtesy.
lines.plainText: Of your fair courtesy

lines.text: I am at your grace's pleasure.
lines.plainText: I am at your grace's pleasure

lines.text: Princes, it is too late to talk of love;
lines.plainText: Princes it is too late to talk of love

lines.text: And that's the mark I know you level at:
lines.plainText: And that's the mark I know you level at

lines.text: Therefore each one betake him to his rest;
lines.plainText: Therefore each one betake him to his rest

lines.text: Tomorrow all for speeding do their best.
lines.plainText: Tomorrow all for speeding do their best
